summary.text: Vega is a South Bronx political organizer affiliated with the LaRouche movement who ran unsuccessfully in the 2026 Democratic primary and appears on the general-election ballot on the Speak The Truth Party line. His platform centers on Medicare for All, reindustrializing the Bronx, immigration reform, and ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars.

paragraphs.text: Born in New York City in 1998 and raised in the South Bronx, according to his campaign website; Ballotpedia lists him as having attended Bronx Community College and worked as a barista.

Describes working with the LaRouche movement since age 16, helping organize concerts, youth choruses, and science programs for teenagers; Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Schiller Institute and the LaRouche Organization.
Ran for NY-15 in 2024 on the LaRouche Party line, receiving 2.4% of the vote; his campaign describes that run as an independent candidacy.
Ran in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary, finishing third with 5.7% behind Torres and Michael Blake, and is on the November ballot on the Speak The Truth Party line.
